name: TributeGiftManager
tagline: Every in-memory gift acknowledged – and every family told – on time.
description: A complete tribute giving app for nonprofits in one Power Platform control: in memory, in honour and celebration gifts grouped into tribute pages with goals and messages, a two-track acknowledgement queue (donor thank-yous and family notifications) with SLAs, consolidated family letters that respect anonymity and amount privacy, a status board and a mail-merge export.
features: Tribute pages per honoree with goal progress, family contact and donor messages
Acknowledgement queue: donor thank-yous and family notifications with configurable SLAs
Consolidated family letters (one per honoree) with anonymous donors and private amounts
Donor thank-you letter preview and download, LetterText output for Power Automate
Workflow New → Verified → Queued → Family notified → Completed with hold, returned and cancelled side tracks
Rules: family contact required, valid email for email notifications, dates not in the future
Kanban board with drag-and-drop and keyboard Move menu
Bulk verify, queue, thank and notify; mail-merge CSV; undo
Demo mode with 240 fictional gifts and 34 honorees
